case_study.lead: A habit-tracking web app designed to make everyday wellbeing feel more approachable.
case_study.description: Fjera combines habit tracking with a personal bird companion that guides and motivates users through small daily challenges.
case_study.research: I tested the concept with five users through Think Aloud testing and used their feedback to refine the onboarding, challenges and overall user experience.
case_study.result: A calm and supportive digital experience that makes building healthy habits feel less like a checklist and more personal.

case_study.lead: A high-end multi-brand fashion webshop designed around individuality and self-expression.
case_study.description: To-K-You reimagines the online fashion experience as a digital gallery, where unique designer pieces become the centre of attention.
case_study.approach: The concept focuses on visual hierarchy, usability and creating a distinctive shopping experience for users who see fashion as a form of self-expression.

sections.name: About me
sections.copy: I'm Nanna, a designer, developer and creator based in Denmark. I turn rough ideas into apps and websites that people enjoy using. With a keen eye for detail, a creative mindset, and plenty of Pepsi Max, I have worked on a wide range of projects—both through my studies and personal passion projects. These include websites, web applications, and e-commerce solutions, where I enjoy combining functionality with thoughtful, aesthetic design.
